thesis: Apple holds its 'Surprise and Shine' event on 9 September, two days from now, for the iPhone 18 Pro and the foldable iPhone Ultra. The base rate for owning Apple into its own September event is the least favourable setup in large-cap tech: the news is already in the price and the reaction is a coin flip on details nobody can forecast. RSI 64 into a binary event, with China and Siri unresolved, is not an edge.
bull_case: A dated, certain catalyst: Apple confirmed the event for Wed 9 Sep 2026 at Apple Park, announcing iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and the first foldable, plus Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4. A genuine new form factor is the first real hardware category expansion in years and could restart an upgrade cycle rather than iterate one. Expectations are not elevated - the stock is down ~9% in 2026 - so the bar to surprise is low, and packet structure is constructive: close 319.97, close > SMA50 > SMA200, 3m momentum +4.2%.
bear_case: Sell-the-news is the base rate here and everything else is a live wound. China: UBS flagged sharp year-on-year iPhone shipment declines in early 2026, and Apple's July quarter disappointed in both the China unit and Services. AI: the improved Siri has slipped repeatedly and Apple is now reportedly leaning on Google's Gemini in the cloud - an admission, not a strategy. Legal: the DOJ suit over iMessage and the App Store is a multi-year overhang, and a separate DOJ trial is examining the Google search deal that pays Apple a large, high-margin annuity. Supply: component shortages already caused Apple's worst decline in 16 months. Score +0.39 is near the bottom of our US holdings, and RSI 64 says the pre-event drift has already happened.
catalysts: 9 Sep 2026 'Surprise and Shine' event: iPhone 18 Pro, foldable iPhone Ultra
Pre-order and first-weekend sales data in the two weeks after
DOJ ruling on the Google search deal
risks: Sell-the-news reaction on 9 Sep with the drift already in the price
China iPhone shipment declines and local competition
Siri/AI delays and dependence on Google Gemini
DOJ antitrust suit and the Google search-deal trial
Component shortages constraining the launch quarter
invalidation: Flips long on a daily close above 335 held for three sessions after the 9 Sep event - post-event strength is the only version of this that is not a drift trade; the bear case confirms on a close below 305, which breaks the SMA50 and the pre-event base.
